name: @skills-manager/desktop
description: Electron React TypeScript SQLite based Skills Manager App.
author: MagicFuture

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:main && concurrently -k "pnpm run dev:renderer" "cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3700 electron ."
scripts.build:main: node scripts/generate-app-config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && (node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>f.rmSync('dist/main',{recursive:true,force:true}))" || true) && esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/main/main/index.js
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.check: node scripts/generate-app-config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.main.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts drizzle.config.ts components.json scripts src
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.main.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts drizzle.config.ts components.json scripts src
